visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a grey t-shirt and light blue jeans squats on a wooden floor, helping a young girl in a pink sleeveless top and denim shorts. They are focused on a wooden spinning top and a white string in a bright indoor living room with a play tent behind them. (2) The girl attempts to spin the top; it successfully rotates on the floor. The girl jumps with excitement, holding a grey plush toy, while the woman smiles. A second child in a green shirt is partially visible on the floor. (3) A different woman in an orange t-shirt and white shorts stands up and throws the spinning top, but it falls over immediately. The girl in the pink top watches closely from a squatting position. (4) The woman in orange tries again, successfully launching the top which spins rapidly. The girl cheers and claps her hands, her face lit with a wide smile. (5) The girl in pink sits on the floor watching the top, then claps her hands together as the woman in orange speaks. The scene cuts to a pink background with a cartoon illustration of a girl and text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a friendly adult female voice instructing a child, accompanied by the low-frequency rustling of hands on clothing. A sharp snapping sound of a string being pulled is heard, followed by a resonant wooden thud as an object hits the floor. (2) A distinctive, high-pitched whirring sound (spinning top) sustains as two females cheer 'Ah!' with high vocal arousal. Enthusiastic, rhythmic clapping follows. (3) A sudden, dull thud indicates a failed attempt, followed by light adult laughter and the phrase 'Suan le' (forget it) in a teasing, low-pitch tone. (4) Another sharp string pull occurs, leading to a long, clean spinning whir. A child's voice yells 'Jia you' with high valence. The audio finishes with a short, bright synthesizer jingle and giggling.
